purpose: Test a frozen causal reference-geometry video codec plus a block-autoregressive latent rectified-flow transformer. M6 v2 replaces the earlier factorised proposal before training with full spatiotemporal attention and 3D RoPE, matching the public Wan/CogVideoX denoiser family more closely while retaining an immutable clean-history prefix.

frozen_model.codec_checkpoint_and_latent_stats: record exact SHA256 after visual codec gate
frozen_model.backbone: full spatiotemporal DiT with signed local temporal and spatial 3D RoPE
frozen_model.reference_difference: Wan/CogVideoX-style flattened video-token attention, augmented with a block-AR immutable-prefix mask; this is not a scaled reproduction
frozen_model.teacher_forcing: clean ground-truth history during training; generated history during rollout

validation.claim_limit: Denoising losses are optimization diagnostics, not perceptual video quality metrics.

final_evaluation.paired_noise_policy: materialize one complete latent-noise tensor per seed; R0 consumes it jointly and M6 consumes the identical tensor in temporal block slices
final_evaluation.real_reference: same split, one camera (c0) per distinct source motion, 100 frames at 20 fps
qualitative_panels: fixed prompt and explicit noise seed
claim_limits: Prompt sensitivity is not semantic prompt correctness.
Palette centroids are visible part proxies, not anatomical joint estimates.
Real-reference metrics are distributional reference values, not paired ground truth for each generated motion.
A single training seed is feasibility evidence, not an architecture ranking.

extension_rule: Preserve 10k as the declared run. Extend with the same checkpoint-bound protocol only if the final-quarter fixed continuation validation remains materially improving and milestone videos remain non-collapsed; report the extension separately.
